android.desc:
Turn your daily tongue photo into a personal TCM wellness journal - bringing over 2,000 years of Traditional Chinese Medicine tongue observation into the modern era, powered by AI.

Snap your tongue. Track color, coating, moisture, and features that TCM practitioners have used for centuries as a window into the body's balance, qi flow, and constitutional patterns.

Free daily tongue scanning. No credit card. Nothing to cancel - ever.

IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER: TongueRead is NOT a medical device. This app does not diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment.

WHY TONGUE OBSERVATION MATTERS IN TCM
In Traditional Chinese Medicine, the tongue is a mirror of the body's internal state. Practitioners have used it for 2,000+ years to observe patterns of balance, qi flow, meridian activity, and constitutional tendencies. TongueRead brings that ancient practice into a daily photo habit - an AI-assisted TCM tongue journal you can build over weeks and months.

Whether you're deeply interested in Traditional Chinese Medicine, working with a TCM practitioner or acupuncturist, exploring holistic wellness, or curious about what your tongue reveals - TongueRead gives you a lens on patterns you'd otherwise miss.

FEATURES
- AI Tongue Analysis: photo-based wellness insights rooted in TCM principles
- TCM Tongue Journal: track color, coating, moisture, and features
- TCM Constitution Profile: learn your body type based on TCM tradition
- Wellness Score: watch your overall pattern shift over time
- Meal & Habit Tracking: log meals, symptoms, and habits to spot patterns in energy, digestion, sleep
- Progress History: see how your tongue evolves week over week
- Community: connect with others exploring TCM and holistic wellness
- Personalized Plans: wellness routines based on your TCM constitution

WHO IS IT FOR
- Anyone curious about Traditional Chinese Medicine and tongue observation
- Wellness seekers building a daily habit rooted in ancient practice
- People working with a TCM practitioner, acupuncturist, herbalist, or naturopath who want a scan journal to share
- Observation-over-diagnosis explorers of energy, digestion, qi, and constitutional balance
- Ayurveda and holistic practitioners exploring tongue observation traditions

COMMON PATTERNS TCM TONGUE OBSERVATION EXPLORES
- Energy and qi patterns: shifts with your daily energy levels
- Digestion

quotes.text:
Klaros AI is a new medical AI designed by a team of researchers and doctors in China and Singapore that will revolutionize the practice of medicine.

Drawing on the best of systems biology from Chinese Medicine, microbiome science, and metabolomics research, it is able to provide a comprehensive health assessment just based on photos of your tongue and answering a few questions.

It will give you a breakdown of your gut bacteria percentages, offer self care suggestions, and recommend high quality botanical formulas and supplements that can shipped directly to your home. It will soon be able to connect you to providers in your area for more specialized care, and will be able to synch up with EHR systems so it can function as a provider tool.
